audio_policy: SUPERSEDED. This recorded that the Effects install left the ExMateria Sound/SPU addons untouched, which was true of that pass. Both addons, third_party/exmateria-sound, tools/audio and docs/audio-installation.md were removed afterwards for relicensing; nothing in this selection depended on them (exmateria_effects deps are platform/render/schema, and its one runtime reach goes through exmateria_platform SfxPort, whose absent path is the engine own not-ready behaviour).
distribution_policy: MIT source delivery via tools/effects/package_release.py. The selection's upstream licence is godot-learning/LICENSE (MIT, installed verbatim as LICENSES/ExMateria-MIT.txt); the monorepo ROOT stays GPL-3.0 for packages this selection does not draw from, and godot-learning's own vendor/ trees are carved out of the MIT grant — none of them are in this selection. The original TacticsTemplateG MIT grant in LICENSE.txt and the remaining third-party notices are retained. No release approval.
